61265-the-outlaws-of-cave-in-rock-histor.title: old Natchez Trace
61265-the-outlaws-of-cave-in-rock-histor.creator: Unknown
61265-the-outlaws-of-cave-in-rock-histor.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. This book is intended to give the authentic story of the famous Cave-in-Rock of the lower Ohio River, as collected from historic and romantic sources, and to present verified accounts of the most notorious of those highwaymen and river pirates who in the early days of the middle West and South filled the Mississippi basin with the alarm and terror of their crimes and exploits.

arxiv-2103-04478.title: Secrecy Outage of Dual-hop Regenerative Multi-relay System with Relay Selection
arxiv-2103-04478.creator: Chinmoy Kundu, Sarbani Ghose, Ranjan Bose
arxiv-2103-04478.description: Abstract Relay selection is considered to enhance the secrecy of a dual-hop regenerative multi-relay system with an eavesdropper. Without assuming perfect decoding at the relays, the secrecy outage probability of a single relay system is obtained first. Secrecy outage of optimal, traditional and suboptimal relay selection schemes is then evaluated.

arxiv-2109-00601.title: Latin writing styles analysis with Machine Learning New approach to old questions
arxiv-2109-00601.creator: Arianna Di Bernardo, Simone Poetto, Sillano Pietro, Beatrice Villata, Weronika Sójka, Zofia Piętka-Danilewicz, Piotr Pranke
arxiv-2109-00601.description: Abstract In the Middle Ages texts were learned by heart and spread using oral means of communication from generation to generation. Adaptation of the art of prose and poems allowed keeping particular descriptions and compositions characteristic for many literary genres.

arxiv-2306-17631.title: A simple method for programming and analyzing multilevel crystallization states in phase-change materials thin films
arxiv-2306-17631.creator: Arnaud Taute, Sadek Al-Jibouri, Capucine Laprais, Stéphane Monfray, Julien Lumeau, Antonin Moreau, Xavier Letartre, Nicolas Baboux, Guillaume Saint-Girons, Lotfi Berguiga, Sébastien Cueff
arxiv-2306-17631.description: Abstract We propose and demonstrate a simple method to accurately monitor and program arbitrary states of partial crystallization in phase-change materials (PCMs). The method relies both on the optical absorption in PCMs as well as on the physics of crystallization kinetics.

arxiv-2312-11638.title: Cutting circuits with multiple two-qubit unitaries
arxiv-2312-11638.creator: Lukas Schmitt 1,2 , Christophe Piveteau 1 , and David Sutter 2
arxiv-2312-11638.description: Abstract Quasiprobabilistic cutting techniques allow us to partition large quantum circuits into smaller subcircuits by replacing non-local gates with probabilistic mixtures of local gates. The cost of this method is a sampling overhead that scales exponentially in the number of cuts.

arxiv-2402-16756.title: Exact Jacobi elliptic solutions of the a ​ b ​ c ​ d abcd -system
arxiv-2402-16756.creator: JAKE DANIELS 1 and NGHIEM V. NGUYEN 1
arxiv-2402-16756.description: Abstract In this manuscript, consideration is given to the existence of periodic traveling-wave solutions to the a ​ b ​ c ​ d abcd -system. This system was derived by Bona, Saut, and Chen to describe small amplitude, long wavelength gravity waves on the surface of water. These exact solutions are formulated in terms of the Jacobi elliptic function cnoidal.

arxiv-2410-01924.title: On bounds of entropy and total curvature for ancient curve shortening flows
arxiv-2410-01924.creator: Wei-Bo Su, Kai-Wei Zhao
arxiv-2410-01924.description: Abstract . Bounds of total curvature and entropy are two common conditions placed on mean curvature flows. We show that these two hypotheses are equivalent for the class of ancient complete embedded smooth planar curve shortening flows, which are one-dimensional mean curvature flows.

arxiv-2411-00179.title: What Makes An Expert? Reviewing How ML Researchers Define “Expert”
arxiv-2411-00179.creator: Mark Díaz, Angela D.R. Smith
arxiv-2411-00179.description: Abstract Human experts are often engaged in the development of machine learning systems to collect and validate data, consult on algorithm development, and evaluate system performance. At the same time, who counts as an ‘expert’ and what constitutes ‘expertise’ is not always explicitly defined.

arxiv-2412-20192.title: Learning physical unknowns from hydrodynamic shock and material interface features in ICF capsule implosions
arxiv-2412-20192.creator: Daniel A. Serino, Evan Bell, Marc Klasky, Ben S. Southworth, Balasubramanya Nadiga, Trevor Wilcox, Oleg Korobkin
arxiv-2412-20192.description: Abstract In high energy density physics (HEDP) and inertial confinement fusion (ICF), predictive modeling is complicated by uncertainty in parameters that characterize various aspects of the modeled system, such as those characterizing material properties, equation of state (EOS), opacities, and initial conditions. Typically, however, these parameters are not directly observable.

arxiv-2502-01238.title: U ​ ( 1 ) A U(1)_{A} Breaking in Hot QCD in the Chiral Limit
arxiv-2502-01238.description: Abstract We propose a simple instanton-based random matrix model of hot QCD that in the quenched case precisely reproduces the distribution of the lowest lattice overlap Dirac eigenvalues. Even after including dynamical quarks the model can be easily simulated in volumes and for quark masses that will be out of reach for direct lattice simulations in the foreseeable future.

arxiv-2504-00882.title: CrackSQL : A Hybrid SQL Dialect Translation System Powered by Large Language Models
arxiv-2504-00882.creator: Wei Zhou, Yuyang Gao, Xuanhe Zhou, Guoliang Li
arxiv-2504-00882.description: Abstract . Dialect translation plays a key role in enabling seamless interaction across heterogeneous database systems. However, translating SQL queries between different dialects (e.g., from PostgreSQL to MySQL) remains a challenging task due to syntactic discrepancies and subtle semantic variations.

arxiv-2601-20752.title: Spectrum-generating algebra and intertwiners of the resonant Pais-Uhlenbeck oscillator
arxiv-2601-20752.creator: Andreas Fring, Ian Marquette, Takano Taira
arxiv-2601-20752.description: Abstract We study the quantum Pais-Uhlenbeck oscillator at the resonant (equal-frequency) point, where the dynamics becomes non-diagonalisable and the conventional Fock-space construction collapses. At the classical level, the degenerate system admits more than one Hamiltonian formulation generating the same equations of motion, leading to a nontrivial quantisation ambiguity.

Further, the term is extended to the descriptive heading or caption to a document, such as a deed or other instrument, or to a bill or act of parliament.

pmc-10693001.title: Structural genomic variation and migratory behavior in a wild songbird
pmc-10693001.creator: Kira E Delmore, Benjamin M Van Doren, Kristian Ullrich, Teja Curk, Henk P van der Jeugd, Miriam Liedvogel
pmc-10693001.description: Structural variants (SVs) are a major source of genetic variation; and descriptions in natural populations and connections with phenotypic traits are beginning to accumulate in the literature. We integrated advances in genomic sequencing and animal tracking to begin filling this knowledge gap in the Eurasian blackcap.

pmc-10737273.title: INTERPLAY OF COGNITIVE STATUS AND SPOUSAL CAREGIVER PATTERNS ON WELL-BEING
pmc-10737273.creator: Lindsay Ryan
pmc-10737273.description: The current paper investigated the intersection of cognitive status and caregiver characteristics on older adults’ reports of life satisfaction and depressive symptoms. Using a sub-sample from the 2016 Health and Retirement Study Harmonized Cognitive Assessment Protocol (HRS-HCAP), individuals were selected if the HCAP informant was a spouse self-identified caregiver.

pmc-11299396.title: Consider CUX1 variants in children with a variation of sex development: a case report and review of the literature
pmc-11299396.creator: Lynn Tan, Shelley G Young, Andrew H Sinclair, Matthew F Hunter, Katie L Ayers
pmc-11299396.description: BackgroundThe Cut Homeobox 1 (CUX1) gene has been implicated in a number of developmental processes and has recently emerged as an important cause of developmental delay and impaired intellectual development. Individuals with variants in CUX1 have been described with a variety of co-morbidities including variations in sex development (VSD) although these features have not been closely documented.

pmc-11363541.title: Inflammatory diet, gut microbiota and sensorineural hearing loss: a cross-sectional and Mendelian randomization study
pmc-11363541.creator: Yixuan Wang, Jiayi Nie, Kaige Yan, Jing Wang, Xin Wang, Yuxiang Zhao
pmc-11363541.description: AimsInflammatory diets can trigger chronic inflammation and affect gut microbiota. However, the relationship between dietary preferences and sensorineural hearing loss (SNHL) remains unclear. This study aims to elucidate the relationship between different dietary preferences and sensorineural deafness.MethodsThe Dietary Inflammation Index (DII) and SNHL were defined by data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), and exploring their relationship.

pmc-11594754.title: A Comparative Analysis of Carlevale IOL Versus Artisan IOL Implantation Using a Scleral Tunnel Incision Technique
pmc-11594754.creator: Justus Obergassel, Peter Heiduschka, Florian Alten, Nicole Eter, Christoph R Clemens, Andrzej Grzybowski
pmc-11594754.description: Background: The aim of this retrospective study was to compare the surgical and refractive outcomes using the Carlevale IOL (FIL SSF; SOLEKO) with those of the retropupillary-fixated Artisan IOL (Aphakia Model 205; OPHTEC), implanted through a 6 mm sclerocorneal tunnel incision in both groups. Methods: This study included 51 consecutive eyes (25 Carlevale and 26 Artisan IOLs).

pmc-12565919.title: Structural Engineering in Sn-Doped WO3 Multi-Phase Systems for Enhanced Transparent Heat Insulation
pmc-12565919.creator: Xinyu Song, Ze Wang, Yue Liu, Xin Li, Chun Du, Shifeng Wang
pmc-12565919.description: Building energy conservation through the development of transparent thermal insulation materials that selectively block near-infrared radiation while maintaining visible light transmittance has emerged as a key strategy for global carbon neutrality. WO3 is a semiconductor oxide with near-infrared absorption capabilities.

pmc-12590726.title: A methodology for developing dermatological datasets: lessons from retrospective data collection for AI-based applications
pmc-12590726.creator: Alma Pedro, Pamela Romero, Soledad Vidaurre, Ana M Cabanas, Atsuko Galaz, Leonel Hidalgo, Karina Carrasco, José Gerardo Tamez-Peña, Ricardo Díaz-Domínguez, Cristian Navarrete-Dechent, Domingo Mery
pmc-12590726.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeThe integration of artificial intelligence into dermatological research has underscored the need for robust and well-structured dermatological datasets. However, these datasets vary widely in their development processes, and there is currently no standard methodology to create such datasets.

pmc-12628401.title: Adequacy of pharmacological prescription in patients at very high risk of fracture within the FLS in Spain: analysis of the REFRA FLS-SEIOMM Registry
pmc-12628401.creator: M J Montoya-Garcia, C Carbonell-Abella, M Giner García, B Hernández-Cruz, C Gómez-Vaquero, A Naranjo, R Izquierdo Aviñó, D Mifsut Miedes, A P Mozo Muriel, J Mora-Fernández, S Castro Oreiro, D Ovejero Crespo, M Jordà Llona, C Alvarado Escobar, M M Femenías Sureda, L Cuadra-Llopart, M Mesa Ramos, S Sa
pmc-12628401.description: SummaryThis study classifies osteoporotic patients treated in 16 FLS in Spain, evaluating therapeutic alignment with SEIOMM recommendations and imminent risk fracture. Findings indicate that 26.8% of patients are at very high-risk fracture, highlighting the need for better prescription practices for osteoanabolics. Fall prevention is pivotal in reducing new fractures.

pmc-13173148.title: 392 Mechanisms of resistance of STP938 in ovarian cancer
pmc-13173148.creator: Hannah Smith, Xiyin Wang, Michael J. Emch, Esther B.P. Rodman, Noa Odell, Nicole A. Pearson, John J. Weroha, Philip A. Beer, John R. Hawse
pmc-13173148.description: Objectives/Goals: Ovarian cancer is the most lethal gynecologic cancer with emergence of recurrent and resistant disease being frequent. We sought to identify novel ways to effectively kill chemotherapy-resistant forms of ovarian cancer and to prevent recurrence following curative intent with surgical and adjuvant regimens.
